asobeast.description: Official MCP server for AsoBeast, an open-source App Store Optimization tool for the App Store and Google Play. Read daily keyword ranks to position 200, keyword popularity and difficulty, competitors and their listing changes, reviews, audits and the ASO to-do list. 37 read tools; a token with the write scope adds 7 tools that track keywords and manage competitors. Create the token under Integrations in AsoBeast (https://asobeast.com/mcp). On a self-hosted instance, use https://your-host/api/backend/mcp as the URL.
